findings.title: 23 of u_alice's memories are labelled broader than one conversation but will be deleted with their thread
findings.detail: The extractor labelled these as broader than one conversation, but each is stored on a thread, and deleting that thread cascades to them. A user's preferences can vanish when an old support thread is cleaned up.

Before deleting a thread, copy the memories you want to keep to user level:
memory.add_memory(content, user_id="…", memory_type="preference")  # no thread_id
